principle: Facilities combine continuous operational watches with day/peak work, tenancy hours and resident life. A station is not staffed as if every person were a starship watchstander.

starfleet.rule: Use only for operator duty functions requiring shift coverage; shops, research projects and civil services may have separate schedules.

alien_operator_rule: Where canon does not establish watch terminology, use operator-local custom watch identifiers and never claim Starfleet labels as canon.
micro_outpost_rule: Tiny stations may use automation + alternating active/on-call personnel rather than pretending to have three complete human teams.
resident_life_rule: Permanent residents have personal schedules separate from station duty schedules.
visitor_rule: Visitors and docked crews follow their own schedule/ship duty state and station access rules.
fatigue_rule: Extended crisis staffing creates fatigue debt and service degradation; the generator may not silently produce fresh staff.
